summary: Implemented PatchIter and the reworked GridPatchDataset per the spec. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch view, coordinates); set_rnd skips "__" attributes), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset takes dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; float alias fix in PatchDataset docstring), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc), and new tests/test_grid_dataset.py (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_len). Nothing was run, per instructions, so pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py is still unverified. Main risk: the pinned single-process values use rtol 1e-5 with 4-decimal literals, so rounding may cause failures. Both test images are assumed to be np.arange(16).reshape(1,4,4). Changes are uncommitted.
